refreshNotes: Inaugural year of the all-electric G 580 with EQ Technology. 116 kWh usable / 122 kWh gross battery, quad-motor architecture (one per wheel), 579 hp combined. 239 mi EPA range. Off-road features: G-Turn (rotate in place), G-Steering (reduced turning radius). MSRP starts ~$162,650. Source: https://www.mbusa.com/en/vehicles/class/g-class/suv
